latest_release.body:
<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at main -->

## What's Changed
* Recommend CLT 16.4 on Sequoia by @p-linnane in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24686
* dependencies_helpers: key test cache by root by @hyuraku in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24670
* Skip runner Docker image jobs on release by @p-linnane in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24684
* Add `Homebrew/NoUntypedKeywordRest` cop by @dduugg in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24678
* info: list installed build dependents by @HaraldNordgren in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24681
* Add shared formula DSL helpers by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24672
* Resolve installed formula prefixes offline by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24692
* Keep prefix libexec optional during post-install by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24691
* Preserve name-only and run-only API services by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24690
* brew.sh: don't source an inherited HOMEBREW_BASH_COMMAND by @carlocab in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24693
* Simplify command and tooling type assertions by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24687
* Simplify runtime type assertions by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24688
* Simplify type assertions in formulae and taps by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24673
* Simplify cask assertions and enable the cop by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24674
* brew.sh, os.sh: harden against inherited environment values by @carlocab in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24694
* rubocops/deprecate_disable: don't guess dates by @krehel in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24696
* Type positional RuboCop node matcher patterns by @dduugg in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24700
* Route issue reports by Homebrew support tier by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24698
* Improve root API cache guidance by @zeldrisho in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24702
* rubocops/components_redundancy: extend sha256 & git revision audit by @cho-m in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24520
* info: show "auto updates" not "auto_updates" by @HaraldNordgren in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24708
* Unify formula and cask lifecycle handling by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24703
* Share DSL modules between formulae and casks by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24704
* Order pre-releases before lettered patches by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24714
* Flag unchanged CSV auto_updates apps as outdated by @kris-anderson in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24709
* rubocops/text: remove `env :userpaths` check by @cho-m in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24545
* Add a cop for partially split method chains by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24716
* Protect Homebrew repositories on package upgrades by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24711
* superenv: target the major macOS version by @p-linnane in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24722
* Audit both deprecate! and disable! reasons by @p-linnane in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24719
* Prefer disabled in remaining lifecycle checks by @p-linnane in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24720
* info, search: label incompatible formulae and casks by @HaraldNordgren in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24669
* Type check more splatted calls by @dduugg in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24721
* Enforce one dotted call per line in wrapped chains by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24717
* Enforce the attestation trust policy by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24715
* Redraw download progress from the first column by @MikeMcQuaid in https://gith

hot_issues.title: `brew upgrade` prompts to upgrade to the same version
`auto_updates` cask `sonos` is always reported outdated with identical installed and current versions

detail.readme: # 🍺 Homebrew [![Latest GitHub release](https://img.shields.io/github/release/Homebrew/brew.svg)](https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/releases) [![BSD-2-Clause License](https://img.shields.io/github/license/Homebrew/brew)](https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/blob/HEAD/LICENSE.txt) [![GitHub Sponsors](https://img.shields.io/github/sponsors/homebrew?label=GitHub%20Sponsors)](https://github.com/sponsors/Homebrew) [![Open Collective backers and sponsors](https://img.shields.io/opencollective/all/homebrew?label=Open%20Collective)](https://opencollective.com/homebrew) See [Homebrew's homepage at `brew.sh`](https://brew.sh) for installation instructions, what homebrew does, packages, `brew bundle` and more. ## 💸 Donations Homebrew is a non-profit project run entirely by volunteers, not employees. We need your funds to pay for software, hardware and hosting around continuous integration and future improvements to the project. Every donation will be spent on making Homebrew better for our users. Please consider a regular donation through [GitHub Sponsors](https://github.com/sponsors/Homebrew), [Open Collective](https://opencollective.com/homebrew) or [Patreon](https://www.patreon.com/homebrew). Read about [sponsoring Homebrew](https://docs.brew.sh/Sponsoring-Homebrew). Homebrew is fiscally hosted by the [Open Source Collective](https://opencollective.com/opensource). ## 📚 Documentation Read the Homebrew manual with [`man brew`](https://docs.brew.sh/Manpage). Read [installation](https://docs.brew.sh/Installation), [troubleshooting](https://docs.brew.sh/Troubleshooting), [contribution](https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/blob/HEAD/docs/How-To-Open-a-Homebrew-Pull-Request.md) including the [FAQ](https://docs.brew.sh/FAQ) on [`docs.brew.sh`](https://docs.brew.sh/). Read the [Homebrew Blog](https://brew.sh/blog/) for release notes, project updates and announcements. ## 📦 Packages Find [formulae](https://formulae.brew.sh/formula/), [casks](https://formulae.brew.sh/cask/), dependencies, versions and package metadata on [`formulae.brew.sh`](https://formulae.brew.sh). View anonymised install, build and operating system usage data at [`formulae.brew.sh/analytics`](https://formulae.brew.sh/analytics/). Read how Homebrew uses [Anonymous Analytics](https://docs.brew.sh/Analytics). ## 🔧 Get Help First, please run `brew update` and run (and **read**) `brew doctor`. Second, read the [Troubleshooting Checklist](https://docs.brew.sh/Troubleshooting). **If you don't read these it will take us far longer to help you with your problem.** After this, if you still need help, please ask in [Homebrew/discussions](https://github.com/orgs/Homebrew/discussions) or follow (and **read**) the [Homebrew/brew new issue chooser](https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/issues/new/choose). ## 💬 Social Follow Homebrew on [Mastodon](https://fosstodon.org/@homebrew), [Bluesky](https://bsky.app/profile/brew.sh), [𝕏 (Twitter)](https://x.com/MacHomebrew) or subscribe to the [newsletter](https://buttondown.email/homebrew). ## 🤝 Contributing We'd love you to join us and >10,000 others by contributing to Homebrew! First, please read our [Contribution Guide](CONTRIBUTING.md) and [Code of Conduct](https://github.com/Homebrew/.github/blob/HEAD/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md#code-of-conduct). A good starting point for contributing is: - `brew tap --force homebrew/core` or `brew tap --force homebrew/cask` (depending on whether you'd rather work on formulae or casks) - perform a strict audit on a package you use e.g. `brew audit --strict ffmpeg` for FFmpeg - if no warnings, run `brew audit --strict` to run on all packages and pick one to fix - read through the warnings and fix them until `brew audit --strict ` shows no results - [submit a pull request](https://docs.brew.sh/How-To-Open-a-Homebrew-Pull-Request) with your fixes Alternatively, for something more substantial, check out one of the open issues in [Homebrew/brew](https://github.com/homebrew/brew/issues), [Homebrew/homebrew-core](https://github.com/homebrew/homebrew-core/issues) or [Homebrew/homebrew-cask](https://github.com/homebrew/homebrew-cask/issues). If you've had inspiration for a new feature or bug fix: we don't need you to open an issue first, just [open a pull request](https://docs.brew.sh/How-To-Open-a-Homebrew-Pull-Request) with your implementation and we'll review it. Good luck! ## 🔐 Security Please see [our security policy](https://github.com/Homebrew/.github/blob/HEAD/SECURITY.md) for how to report security issues and what is in scope. ## 👥 Who We Are Homebrew's [Project Leader](https://docs.brew.sh/Homebrew-Governance#project-leader) is [Mike McQuaid](https://github.com/MikeMcQuaid). Homebrew's [Lead Maintainers](https://docs.brew.sh/Homebrew-Governance#lead-maintainer) are [Bevan Kay](https://github.com/bevanjkay), [Carlo Cabrera](https://github.com/carlocab), [Justin Krehel](https://github.com/krehel), [Michael Cho](https://github.com/cho-m), [Mike McQuaid](https://github.com/MikeMcQuaid), [Nanda H Krishna](https://github.com/nandahkrishna), [Patrick Linnane](https://github.com/p-linnane), [Rui Chen](https://github.com/chenrui333), [Ruoyu Zhong](https://github.com/ZhongRuoyu), [Sam Ford](https://github.com/samford) and [Sean Molenaar](https://github.com/SMillerDev). Homebrew's [Security Team](https://docs.brew.sh/Homebrew-Governance#4-security--emergency-actions) members are [Andrew Nesbitt](https://github.com/andrew), [Mike McQuaid](https://github.com/MikeMcQuaid), [Patrick Linnane](https://github.com/p-linnane) and [William Woodruff](https://github.com/woodruffw). Homebrew's other Maintainers are [Andrew Nesbitt](https://github.com/andrew), [Anton Melnikov](https://github.com/botantony), [Bo Anderson](https://github.com/Bo98), [Branch Vincent](https://github.com/branchv), [Caleb Xu](https://github.com/alebcay), [Daeho Ro](https://github.com/daeho-ro), [Douglas Eichelberger](https://github.com/dduugg), [Dustin Rodrigues](https://github.com/dtrodrigues), [FX Coudert](https://github.com/fxcoudert), [Harald Nordgren](https://github.com/HaraldNordgren), [Issy Long](https://github.com/issyl0), [Klaus Hipp](https://github.com/khipp), [Markus Reiter](https://github.com/reitermarkus), [Michka Popoff](https://github.com/iMichka), [Štefan Baebler](https://github.com/stefanb), [Thierry Moisan](https://github.com/Moisan), [William Woodruff](https://github.com/woodruffw) and [hyuraku](https://github.com/hyuraku). Homebrew was originally created by [Max Howell](https://github.com/mxcl). ## 📜 License Code is under the [BSD 2-clause "Simplified" License](LICENSE.txt).
